narrative.hero: How optical measurements shape what machines can infer.
narrative.short_bio: I study how optical measurements shape what machines can infer, and how to make that inference reliable with limited, noisy data. I connect measurement design, reconstruction and direct inference to understand what makes perception robust.
narrative.current_summary: Time-domain diffuse optical tomography for 3D brain imaging; acquisition-aware single-pixel sensing on an optical bench; exploratory question answering from measurements with a frozen vision–language model.
narrative.welcome: I welcome research collaborations and internships that combine measurements and physical models to help machines learn and reason reliably, with applications in scientific discovery and embodied systems.
narrative.long_term: My long-term aim is to help robots interpret the physical world from raw measurements and physical models.
